evidence.observation: Monotonic pressure rise during growth from ~3.05 to 3.377 Torr (k=21..25) while Ar flow and T hold at setpoint
Flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the rise is not a flow increase
Sensor not installed; inert atmosphere cannot be verified, so leak vs. exhaust restriction cannot be distinguished

args.missing_evidence: Exhaust O2 (not installed) or an equivalent test: a pump-down/flow-step response (e.g., briefly reduce Ar setpoint) — pressure tracking flow implies restriction, pressure holding implies an air leak.
